scripts.build: npm run build -w @signalwire/react && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-native
scripts.test: npm run test -w @signalwire/react && npm run test -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run test -w @signalwire/react-native && npm run test -w @signalwire/rn-push-server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-native && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-native-example && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-web-example && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/rn-push-server
scripts.bundle-check: npm run bundle-check -w @signalwire/react-native-example && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-web-example
scripts.verify:package: npm run build && cd packages/react-native && npx publint && npx @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack . --exclude-entrypoints app.plugin.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm test && npm run bundle-check
